projekti.heading: Dostojanstven rad počinje dok si mlad
projekti.body:
Period: 15.03.2022. – 14.03.2023.
Trajanje: 12 mjeseci
Finansira: Evropska unija i Ministarstvo javne uprave Crne Gore
Partneri: NVO Prima (https://nvoprima.org/), Fondacija Ana i Vlade Divac (https://www.divac.com/en/home), Youth Alliance (https://www.youthalliance.org.mk/), Toplum Gönüllüleri Vakfı (TOG) (https://www.tog.org.tr/en), Partners Albania for Change and Development (https://www.partnersalbania.org/)

Udruženje zaštite na radu Crne Gore je 14.03.2022. godine postalo član YouthHUB mreže Zapadnog Balkana i Turske i uz podršku i koordinaciju NVO Prima je u periodu od 15.03.2022. do 14.03.2023. realizovalo projekat „Dostojanstven rad počinje dok si mlad“, koji je finansirala Evropska komisija i dijelom Ministarstvo javne uprave u Crnoj Gori.

Budući da svi podaci EU OSHA govore da su mladi između 18–24 godine u mnogo većem riziku od povređivanja, a EU strateški okvir zaštite i zdravlja na radu 2022–2027, poseban akcenat stavlja na mlade ljude, cilj ovog projekta je bilo povećanje udjela mladih iz NEET kategorije, kroz unapređenje bezbjednosti na radnim mjestima i izgradnju kulture sprečavanja i oboljevanja.

Kroz istraživanje koje je razvijeno i u kojem je učestvovalo 902 mladih ljudi starosti 16–29 godina, na kraju projektne godine je dobijena jasnija slika o broju povreda koje su mladi ljudi doživjeli na svojim radnim mjestima u posljednjih pet godina, posebno u zoni sive ekonomije. Takođe, na osnovu upitnika koje su mladi ljudi popunili, dobijeni su podaci o vrlo niskom nivou znanja kada je u pitanju zaštita i zdravlje na radu.

Realizovano je 12 edukativnih radionica u srednjim stručnim školama u Podgorici, Bijelom Polju i Nikšiću, kao i na tehničkim fakultetima i na taj način su, barem djelimično, đaci i studenti upoznati sa izazovima i problemima u oblasti zaštite i zdravlja na radu, s kojima će se suočiti dolaskom na tržište rada, nakon završenog procesa obrazovanja.

projekti.heading_en: Decent work starts while you are young
projekti.body_en:
Period: 15 March 2022 – 14 March 2023
Duration: 12 months
Funded by: the European Union and the Ministry of Public Administration of Montenegro
Partners: NGO Prima (https://nvoprima.org/), Ana and Vlade Divac Foundation (https://www.divac.com/en/home), Youth Alliance (https://www.youthalliance.org.mk/), Toplum Gönüllüleri Vakfı (TOG) (https://www.tog.org.tr/en), Partners Albania for Change and Development (https://www.partnersalbania.org/)

On 14 March 2022 the Occupational Safety Association of Montenegro became a member of the YouthHUB network of the Western Balkans and Türkiye, and with the support and coordination of the NGO Prima it carried out the project “Decent work starts while you are young” between 15 March 2022 and 14 March 2023, financed by the European Commission and in part by the Ministry of Public Administration of Montenegro.

Since all EU-OSHA data show that young people aged 18–24 are at a far greater risk of injury, and since the EU strategic framework on health and safety at work 2021–2027 places particular emphasis on young people, the aim of this project was to increase the share of young people from the NEET category by improving workplace safety and building a culture of preventing accidents and illness.

A survey developed for the project, in which 902 young people aged 16–29 took part, gave a clearer picture at the end of the project year of the number of injuries young people had suffered at their workplaces over the previous five years, particularly in the grey economy. The questionnaires the young people completed also showed a very low level of knowledge about occupational safety and health.

Twelve educational workshops were held in secondary vocational schools in Podgorica, Bijelo Polje and Nikšić, as well as at the technical faculties, and in this way pupils and students were made aware, at least in part, of the challenges and problems in occupational safety and health that they will face when they enter the labour market after finishing their education.

projekti.heading: Podizanje kapaciteta i jačanje uloge regionalnih građanskih organizacija u unapređenju uslova rada preko dijaloga sa javnim institucijama
projekti.body:
Period: februar 2016. – jul 2019.
Trajanje: 42 mjeseca
Finansira: Evropska unija
Nosilac: Makedonsko udruženje za zaštitu na radu – MOSHA (https://www.mzzpr.org.mk/)
Partneri: Srpsko udruženje za zaštitu na radu, Albanski centar za bezbjednost i zdravlje na radu, Kosovsko udruženje za zaštitu na radu, Crnogorsko udruženje za zaštitu na radu

Opšti cilj je stvaranje okruženja za dijalog između regionalnih organizacija i javnih institucija radi poboljšanja uslova rada. Ciljna grupa su organizacije civilnog društva iz 5 zemalja korisnica IPA-e, javne institucije, sindikati, organizacije poslodavaca i mediji. Krajnji korisnici su radnici, poslodavci, zaposleni, organizacije civilnog društva iz 5 zemalja korisnica IPA-e, javne institucije i mediji.

Specifični cilj projekta je dinamičnije civilno društvo kroz umrežavanje, zagovaranje, dugoročno strateško organizaciono planiranje i podsticanje nivoa uključenosti i učešća organizacija civilnog društva u procesu donošenja odluka u vezi sa sigurnim i zdravim uslovima rada.

Konačni očekivani rezultati implementacije projekta su: jačanje kapaciteta organizacija civilnog društva za bezbjednost i zdravlje na radu, standarde za uslove rada, zagovaranje, umrežavanje i saradnju sa javnim vlastima; povećati kapacitet OCD za razradu strateških dugoročnih organizacionih planova za bezbjednost i zdravlje na radu, OCD da zagovaraju i koriste najbolje prakse država članica EU kao podršku svojim aktivnostima na regionalnom i nacionalnom nivou; efikasna i široka komunikacija rezultata javnosti i medija u vezi sa organizacijama civilnog društva u okviru regionalne saradnje, umrežavanja, bezbjednosti i zdravlja na radu i uslova rada.

Osnovna ideja za realizaciju ovog projekta je da svi strateški dokumenti budu od značajne pomoći regionalnoj mreži organizacija civilnog društva i BALcanOSH-u u politici stvaranja procesa i postizanju promjena na nacionalnom i regionalnom nivou. Cilj je razviti regionalnu strategiju koja će pomoći vladama da kreiraju i usvoje sopstvene nacionalne strategije zasnovane na preporukama regionalne studije i strategije, i ulože napore da se približe strateškim prioritetima strategije EU o BZR za period 2014–2020.
projekti.heading_en: Building the capacity and strengthening the role of regional civil society organisations in improving working conditions through dialogue with public institutions
projekti.body_en:
Period: February 2016 – July 2019
Duration: 42 months
Funded by: the European Union
Lead organisation: Macedonian Occupational Safety and Health Association – MOSHA (https://www.mzzpr.org.mk/)
Partners: the Serbian occupational safety association, the Albanian Centre for Occupational Safety and Health, the Kosovo occupational safety association, the Montenegrin occupational safety association

The general objective is to create an environment for dialogue between regional organisations and public institutions in order to improve working conditions. The target group is civil society organisations from the 5 IPA beneficiary countries, public institutions, trade unions, employers' organisations and the media. The final beneficiaries are workers, employers, employees, civil society organisations from the 5 IPA beneficiary countries, public institutions and the media.

The specific objective of the project is a more dynamic civil society through networking, advocacy and long-term strategic organisational planning, and through encouraging the involvement and participation of civil society organisations in decision-making on safe and healthy working conditions.

The final expected results of the project are: stronger capacity among civil society organisations in occupational safety and health, standards for working conditions, advocacy, networking and cooperation with public authorities; greater capacity among CSOs to draw up long-term strategic organisational plans for occupational safety and health, and for CSOs to advocate and draw on the best practices of EU member states in support of their activities at regional and national level; and effective, wide communication of the results to the public and the media regarding civil society organisations within regional cooperation, networking, occupational safety and health and working conditions.

The underlying idea behind this project is that all the strategic documents should be of substantial help to the regional network of civil society organisations and to BALcanOSH in shaping policy processes and achieving change at national and regional level. The aim is to develop a regional strategy that will help governments to create and adopt their own national strategies based on the recommendations of the regional study and strategy, and to make an effort to come closer to the strategic priorities of the EU strategic framework on health and safety at work for 2014–2020.

projekti.heading: Pravilima sigurnosti do zdrave budućnosti
projekti.body:
Period: 01.08.2019. – 31.07.2020.
Trajanje: 12 mjeseci
Finansira: Ministarstvo rada i socijalnog staranja Crne Gore

Promocija zaštite i zdravlja na radu i obezbjeđenje sigurnih i zdravih radnih mjesta realizovana je u periodu od 01.08.2019. do 31.07.2020. godine, pod sloganom „Pravilima sigurnosti do zdrave budućnosti“. Sredstva za realizaciju ovog projekta obezbijedilo je Ministarstvo rada i socijalnog staranja. Glavni cilj projekta je bio podizanje nivoa svijesti poslodavaca i zaposlenih, prevencija rizika i smanjenje broja povreda na radnom mjestu i profesionalnih oboljenja.

Kroz seminare, edukacije i radionice, koje je Udruženje zaštite na radu Crne Gore organizovalo za 40 poslodavaca i 160 zaposlenih, poslodavci i zaposleni su se upoznali sa svojim pravima i obavezama kada je zaštita i zdravlje u pitanju, i učinjen je pomak u podizanju nivoa zaštite i zdravlja na radu, posebno kod onih subjekata gdje je postojala pretpostavka da nijesu ispoštovane zakonske odredbe po tom pitanju.

Preko domaćih i regionalnih stručnjaka, učesnici su imali priliku da povećaju svoje znanje o međunarodnim standardima zaštite i zdravlja na radu i Strategiji ZZNR EU, prenijeta su im znanja i iskustva iz susjednih zemalja, kao i sposobnosti socijalnog dijaloga i kolektivnog pregovaranja, umrežavanja i zagovaranja i druge specifične teme.

Kroz realizovane aktivnosti je takođe bilo omogućeno prikupljanje podataka o stvarnom stanju zaštite i zdravlja na radu kod poslodavaca, kao i njihova obrada i analiza. Ova istraživanja su dala jasniju sliku stanja ove oblasti u Crnoj Gori, što je veoma važno s obzirom na činjenicu da se u Crnoj Gori ne raspolaže relevantnim podacima, a što u krajnjem onemogućava racionalnije planiranje i preduzimanje odgovarajućih aktivnosti.

Zbog nezainteresovanosti poslodavaca nije ostvaren glavni cilj da se kroz organizovanje radionica poslodavcima predoči da je ulaganje u zaštitu i zdravlje njihovih zaposlenih – ulaganje u budućnost, čime je trebalo da glavni menadžeri budu stimulisani da se aktivno uključe u smanjenje rizika i obezbjeđivanje zdravih i sigurnih radnih mjesta.

Organizovani su brojni informativni sastanci za zaposlene i predstavnike zaposlenih, na kojima su oni podsticani da učestvuju u kreiranju ambijenta i kulture zaštite i zdravlja na radu u svojim kompanijama, kroz davanje mišljenja i predloga za obezbjeđivanje zdravih i sigurnih radnih mjesta, a predstavnici zaposlenih su podsticani da shvate neophodnost saradnje sa menadžmentom, radi preduzimanja pravih mjera i smanjenja rizika, odnosno izvora opasnosti, koji mogu dovesti do povreda, odnosno profesionalnih oboljenja.

Kao kruna svih realizovanih aktivnosti urađen je promotivni video film o značaju ulaganja u zaštitu i zdravlje na radu, kao i opšti priručnik za zaposlene i poslodavce.

projekti.heading_en: Safety rules for a healthy future
projekti.body_en:
Period: 1 August 2019 – 31 July 2020
Duration: 12 months
Funded by: the Ministry of Labour and Social Welfare of Montenegro

The promotion of occupational safety and health and the provision of safe and healthy workplaces was carried out between 1 August 2019 and 31 July 2020 under the slogan “Safety rules for a healthy future”. The funds for the project were provided by the Ministry of Labour and Social Welfare. The main aim of the project was to raise awareness among employers and employees, to prevent risks and to reduce the number of workplace injuries and occupational diseases.

Through seminars, training sessions and workshops that the Occupational Safety Association of Montenegro organised for 40 employers and 160 employees, employers and employees learned about their rights and obligations in matters of safety and health, and progress was made in raising the level of occupational safety and health, particularly at those organisations where there was reason to believe that the legal provisions on the subject had not been complied with.

Through domestic and regional experts, participants had the opportunity to increase their knowledge of international occupational safety and health standards and of the EU OSH strategy; knowledge and experience from neighbouring countries was passed on to them, along with skills in social dialogue and collective bargaining, networking and advocacy and other specific topics.

The activities carried out also made it possible to collect data on the real state of occupational safety and health at employers, and to process and analyse it. This research gave a clearer picture of the state of the field in Montenegro, which matters a great deal given that Montenegro has no relevant data available — something that ultimately makes more rational planning and appropriate action impossible.

Because of a lack of interest among employers, the main goal was not achieved: to show employers through the workshops that investing in the safety and health of their employees is an investment in the future, which was meant to encourage senior managers to become actively involved in reducing risk and providing healthy and safe workplaces.

Numerous information meetings were held for employees and employees' representatives, at which they were encouraged to take part in creating a climate and culture of occupational safety and health in their companies by giving their opinions and proposals on providing healthy and safe workplaces; employees' representatives were encouraged to recognise the need to work with management in order to take the right measures and reduce the risks and sources of danger that can lead to injuries and occupational diseases.

Crowning all of these activities, a promotional video was made about the importance of investing in occupational safety and health, together with a general handbook for employees and employers.

projekti.heading: Gradi znanje – zaštiti sebe
projekti.body:
Period: 16.03.2020. – 08.10.2021.
Finansira: Javni konkurs „Gradimo zaštitu i zdravlje na radu za XXI vijek!“

Na osnovu Odluke o raspodjeli sredstava broj 106-134/20-670/35 do 17.08.2020. godine, a nakon sprovedenog javnog konkursa „Gradimo zaštitu i zdravlje na radu za XXI vijek!“ (u daljem tekstu: Javni konkurs), broj 106-134/20-670/14, obavljenog 16.03.2020. godine, ovim ugovorom Komisija i korisnik sredstava uređuju međusobna prava i obaveze u finansiranju i sprovođenju projekta „Gradi znanje – zaštiti sebe“, u odnosu na dodijeljeni iznos sredstava od 23.732,00 eura (dvadesettrihiljadesedamstotridesetdva eura).

Krajnji korisnici će biti zaposleni, predstavnici zaposlenih/sindikati, stručna lica iz oblasti zaštite i zdravlja na radu, poslodavci, zaposleni u javnim institucijama – Upravi za inspekcijske poslove i Ministarstvu rada i socijalnog staranja, doktori medicine rada, građanske organizacije, mediji.

Upoznavanjem svih zainteresovanih strana sa ključnim akterima u građevinskom sektoru i načinu na koji se oni staraju da obezbijede dostojanstvene uslove rada, biće potpomognuto promovisanje dostojanstvenog rada i kulture prevencije nesreća na radu. Budući da su kapaciteti socijalnih partnera takođe ograničeni, biće potpomognuto njihovo angažovanje u postizanju prava zaposlenih na zaštitu i zdravlje na radu, kao i pravo na dostojanstvene uslove rada, koji ne bi imali štetne ili fatalne posljedice za vrijeme obavljanja rada.

Kroz projektne aktivnosti će biti uspostavljen zajednički strateški pristup usmjeren na prevenciju i smanjenje povreda i profesionalnih oboljenja i jačanje saradnje među relevantnim službama, kao i sa javnim institucijama, što će dovesti do poboljšanja privatno-javnog partnerstva.

Mediji će steći nova znanja o vrlo bitnom građevinskom sektoru, a kroz svoje priloge o aktivnostima projekta i istraživačke priče, koje će iz toga proizići, doprinijeće podizanju nivoa svijesti svih građana Crne Gore.

projekti.body_en:
Period: 16 March 2020 – 8 October 2021
Funded by: the public call “Let us build occupational safety and health for the 21st century!”

On the basis of Decision on the allocation of funds no. 106-134/20-670/35 of 17 August 2020, following the public call “Let us build occupational safety and health for the 21st century!” (hereinafter: the public call), no. 106-134/20-670/14, held on 16 March 2020, this contract sets out the mutual rights and obligations of the Commission and the recipient of the funds in financing and implementing the project “Build knowledge – protect yourself”, in relation to the awarded amount of EUR 23,732.00 (twenty-three thousand seven hundred and thirty-two euros).

The final beneficiaries will be employees, employees' representatives and trade unions, occupational safety and health professionals, employers, staff of public institutions — the Administration for Inspection Affairs and the Ministry of Labour and Social Welfare — occupational medicine doctors, civil society organisations and the media.

By making all interested parties familiar with the key actors in the construction sector and with the way they go about providing decent working conditions, the project will help promote decent work and a culture of preventing accidents at work. Since the capacity of the social partners is also limited, their engagement will be supported in securing employees' right to safety and health at work, as well as the right to decent working conditions that would not have harmful or fatal consequences while the work is carried out.

The project activities will establish a joint strategic approach aimed at preventing and reducing injuries and occupational diseases and at strengthening cooperation among the relevant services and with public institutions, which will lead to a better public-private partnership.

The media will gain new knowledge about the highly important construction sector, and through their reports on the project's activities and the investigative stories that come out of them they will help raise awareness among all citizens of Montenegro.
